ex.t: 最初把爱好带进课堂时，我关注的是这样做能如何提高参与度、帮助学生理解科学概念。

ex.s: One of the major headaches for her was finding her way in the huge school building.
ex.t: 对她来说，最头疼的事情之一就是在巨大的校舍里找路。

ex.s: Somewhere in the building, there was also a library, a cafeteria, and a gym.
ex.t: 大楼里的某个地方还有一间图书馆、一个食堂和一间健身房。

defs.def: to make sth a permanent part of a system, plan, etc. 使 … 成为（体系、计划等的）组成部分

ex.s: “The ability to design, build and export green technologies for producing clean water, clean air and healthy and abundant food is going to be the currency of power in the new century.”
ex.t: “设计、制造并向其他国家出口用于生产清洁水、清洁空气以及健康丰足食物的绿色技术的能力，将成为新世纪里实力的象征。”

ex.s: A systems approach to creating change is also built on the assumption that everyone in the system has equal power.
ex.t: 创造变革的系统方法还建立在一种假设之上，即系统中的每个人都有平等的权力。

defs.def: to create or develop sth 创建；开发

ex.s: It also helps build strong leg bones.
ex.t: 它还有助于增强腿部骨骼。

defs.def: to make sth higher or stronger than it was before 增高；加强

ex.s: He built a hugely successful career with little more than plain old hard work and determination.
ex.t: 他仅凭朴实的努力和决心，就建立了极其成功的职业生涯。

ex.s: Building up a dream team is more complex than simply hiring the best talent.
ex.t: 组建梦之队比单纯雇佣最优秀的人才更复杂。

ex.s: The café is located upstairs in Building 1 and is open daily until one hour before Pacific Science Center closes.
ex.t: 咖啡厅位于1号楼楼上，每天开放至太平洋科学中心闭馆前一小时。
